reviews.review:
This ain't Alien, sure it's fun with friends for a while but this just feels like a generic sci fi horde shooter wearing a xenomoprh skin, and it's upsetting... I can cut the team some slack that they aren't triple A but jeeze, all they had to do was slap on the Aliens Colonial Marines skin and they would of been golden.

The classic retrofuturistic aesthetic is completely gone in favour of this generic sleek redesign which just looks and feels souless, I mean why did you give the marines CAG slop FAST helmets... why... just why...? Also has some obvious DEI woke elements which are just plain annoying, ugly and out of place.
The weapon sounds especially SMGs are absolutely terrible, only the ARs and shotguns sound like they have any impact (dear God how could you screw up a minigun so badly it sounds like a handcrank gatling gun...).
The music is awful and sounds nothing like Alien most of the time, lacking those iconic stress inducing military drums like in ACM which hyped you up.
The combat is ok at best, the awful weapon sounds and subpar animations could have done a lot more (the heavy weapons are off centre and the reused reload animations for nearly every weapon is just plain lazy).
Xeno specials are pretty jank often grabbing you even if you dodge, or just straight up knock you over even if you're nowhere near them (get ready to be jumped on at every corner).
There's no checkpoints, so get ready to be thrown unceremoniously back to the mission screen if you wipe midway or fail the escape at the end because your teammates are idiots.
The characters though are just plain bland and often annoying, even if it's just 90% the same woman yelling at you down comms.
And lastly the story if you can even call it that follows the awful abomination Prometheus, Covenant and Romulus lore which deserves nothing more then to be retconned and shot out of an airlock into the sun.
Oh yeah almost forgot, every player you'll run into that's prestige will spam shoulder rockets, carry a smartgun and sit in a doorway when enemies show up only to then run off leaving you behind. Lazy pathetic sweats...

Btw there's no M41A.

Get on a sale with friends.

Serving the USCM has been the greatest choice of my life, the weapon system are amazing and they can make any gun a marine can dream of on the ship itself. Join today and trust in the UD-9 Condor because "Xemo's aint got SAMS".
Fun game, scratches a left 4 dead itch I have. Sadly it is just to short. If it's on sale and you have friends then buy it.

A very short game, but fun to play with friends. If you dont have anyone to play with the game assigns you two bots who actually perform well. The shop lets you upgrade your guns. The female character options leave a lot to be desired, they all look very masculine, but it doesn't affect the game too much, still fun.
